title: Standard Terms and Conditions for Suppliers and Partners

clauses.heading: Payment terms
clauses.text: The Company shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty (30) days of receipt. The Company does not accept payment terms shorter than thirty (30) days.

clauses.heading: Limitation of liability
clauses.text: Each party's total aggregate liability under the agreement shall not exceed the fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim. The cap shall apply equally to both parties.

clauses.heading: Excluded losses
clauses.text: Neither party shall be liable for indirect or consequential losses, including loss of profit.

clauses.heading: Termination for convenience
clauses.text: Either party may terminate the agreement for convenience by giving thirty (30) days' written notice.

clauses.heading: Renewal
clauses.text: Any renewal term shall not exceed twelve (12) months, and the notice period required to prevent renewal shall not exceed sixty (60) days.

clauses.heading: Intellectual property
clauses.text: All deliverables created for the Company under the agreement, and all intellectual property rights in them, shall be owned by the Company upon payment.

clauses.heading: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Each party shall keep the other party's confidential information confidential during the agreement and for three (3) years after its termination.

clauses.heading: Penalties
clauses.text: Any penalty for late payment by the Company shall not exceed 0.1% of the overdue amount per day and shall be capped at ten percent (10%) of the overdue amount.

clauses.heading: Governing law
clauses.text: The agreement shall be governed by the laws of the Republic of Azerbaijan, and disputes shall be resolved by the courts of Baku.

clauses.heading: Data protection
clauses.text: The partner shall notify the Company of any personal data breach within seventy-two (72) hours of becoming aware of it.

clauses.heading: Subcontracting
clauses.text: The partner shall not subcontract any part of the services without the Company's prior written consent.
